title: Human Resource Executive : Work From Home : 5.5 Days Work : Apply
description:
Outpace Consulting is looking for dynamic, confident and result-driven HR Recruiters with experience in recruitment or candidate calling. 
 This opportunity is ideal for individuals who enjoy interacting with people, are confident on calls, and have the ability to engage, convince and close candidates. 
 Eligibility & Requirements 
 Graduate in any stream. Minimum 3 months of experience in Recruitment / Candidate Calling. Internship or full-time job experience - both are considered. Strong communication skills in Hindi with basic conversational English. Confident and comfortable with extensive calling and candidate interaction. Good interpersonal, convincing and follow-up skills. Target-oriented and result-driven approach. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Comfortable working with daily calling and hiring targets. Own laptop and stable internet connection are mandatory. 
 Who Are We Looking For? 
 Enjoys talking to and interacting with people. Has a natural flair for calling and candidate engagement. Can confidently explain opportunities and handle candidate objections. Is proactive, disciplined and self-driven. Can take ownership of assigned hiring requirements. Is comfortable working in a performance-driven environment. Is serious about building a long-term career in recruitment. 
 Role Overview 
 As an HR Recruiter, you will manage the recruitment cycle from candidate sourcing and screening to interview coordination, follow-ups, selection and joining closure across multiple hiring requirements. 
 A. Candidate Sourcing & Screening 
 Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, social media, WhatsApp groups, references and other relevant channels. Understand Job Descriptions and hiring requirements. Screen candidates based on experience, eligibility and role requirements. Assess candidates' communication skills and overall suitability. Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline. 
 B. Candidate Calling & Engagement 
 Connect with shortlisted candidates through outbound calls. Explain the job profile, salary, location, shifts, eligibility and selection process. Understand candidate expectations and career requirements. Handle basic queries and objections professionally. Generate candidate interest and drive them towards interviews. 
 C. Interview Coordination & Closure 
 Schedule and coordinate candidate interviews. Maintain regular follow-ups before interviews. Ensure strong interview show-up rates. Track candidate progress through different interview stages. Follow up with selected candidates until joining. Focus on improving selection-to-joining conversion. 
 D. Candidate Management 
 Build professional relationships with candidates. Keep candidates engaged throughout the recruitment process. Provide timely interview and selection updates. Handle candidate dropouts and follow-up requirements. Maintain an organized pipeline of active candidates. 
 E. MIS & Performance Reporting Maintain daily recruitment trackers and MIS. Track calls, screenings, lineups, interviews, selections and joinings. Share daily performance updates with the Team Lead. Work towards assigned recruitment targets and KPIs. Why Join Outpace Consulting? 
 100% Work From Home flexibility. Performance-driven growth opportunities. Hands-on exposure to live recruitment. Opportunity to work across multiple hiring requirements. Strong exposure to candidate sourcing, calling and closure. Fast-paced and learning-oriented work environment. Opportunity to develop practical recruitment and candidate-management skills. 
 This Role Is For You If... 
 You enjoy calling, interacting with people, convincing candidates and achieving hiring targets - and want to build a serious career in recruitment. 
 How to Apply 
 Please apply through Naukri.com. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our recruitment team.

title: Human Resource Business Partner
description:
In this role you will own the full HR lifecycle for employees within the function. Your responsibilities will include supporting the annual workforce planning process, tracking recruitment, enabling effective functional on-boarding, driving performance management, career development and overseeing employee engagement and exit process management. In addition, you will work on function specific programs such as workforce transitions linked to project ramp-ups or ramp-downs. A critical part of your role will be to partner with and coach managers to build a high-performance culture. You will work closely with Recruitment, Operations, Training and Service Managers. 
 Interfaces with: Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Training, Service Managers, Service Head and MD. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Headcount plan & Recruitment: Partner with HRM and leaders on the annual headcount plan and pacing for the year Track and drive recruitment in collaboration with the TA team Ensure timely hiring, aligned to the quality that is defined for each role. 
 Onboarding & Integration: Enable structured onboarding and functional orientation for new hires Track assimilation with 30, 60, 90 day check-ins and the confirmation process 
 Performance Management & Career Development: Partner with business leaders to set clear goals for the annual review period Drive the monthly performance management process (KPIs) with clarity and rigour Put in place Performance Improvement plans (PIPs) to support weak performers Enable career development and internal mobility discussions 
 Employee Engagement & Retention: Conduct regular check-ins and proactively address employee concerns Handle any workplace grievances with care and urgency Cascade all events at a functional level, encouraging participation at site. Reduce voluntary attrition by 10-15% year over year. 
 Business Partnering & Manager Capability: Educate Managers and on the various people processes Increase ownership of people processes with managers 
 HR Process Excellence & Projects: Refine the role of Site HR & improve from process coordination to process ownership Partner with COEs to implement processes with high consistency and compliance Reduce gaps in workflows and processes between the COE teams and Site HR Drive function specific projects effectively with the help and alignment of COEs 
 Key performance Indicators: Headcount plan & Recruitment: % alignment to annual plan, Average Time to Fill Onboarding, Engagement & Retention: New hire confirm rate, % of employees covered through listening circles, Voluntary attrition rate. Performance Management : Average KPI, Rating Spread, etc. Business Partnering & Managers : Improve quality of people decisions, Reduce escalations HR Excellence Key Projects : Delivery on key projects and stakeholder feedback 
 Key Capabilities Required: Strong Partnering and stakeholder management skills Ability to balance operational execution with strategic thinking Clear, structured communication and influencing ability Comfort with data and ability to derive actionable insights High ownership, responsiveness, and problem-solving mindset

title: HR Manager
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a dynamic, people-oriented and proactive HR Manager to lead and strengthen the organisations HR function. The role is primarily focused on recruitment, employee engagement, people management and building a positive workplace culture . The HR Manager will work closely with management and employees to ensure the organisation attracts the right talent, supports employee performance and development, and maintains a healthy and positive work environment. This is a hands-on HR role for someone who enjoys working closely with people, taking ownership of HR activities and contributing directly to the organisations growth. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition 
 Manage the end-to-end recruitment process across different functions and levels. Understand manpower requirements from department heads and management. Source candidates through job portals, professional networks, references and other recruitment channels. Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate discussions. Coordinate interviews and maintain regular communication with candidates. Follow up with selected candidates through the offer and joining process. Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular updates on hiring status. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential candidates for current and future requirements. 
 2. Employee Engagement & Workplace Culture 
 Build positive relationships with employees across different teams. Create a supportive, energetic and employee-friendly work environment. Identify employee concerns and facilitate appropriate discussions with management. Organise employee engagement activities, team interactions and internal initiatives. Encourage open communication and a positive approach to workplace challenges. Contribute towards strengthening employee morale, motivation and team spirit. 
 3. Employee Relations & People Management 
 Act as a point of contact for employees for day-to-day HR-related matters. Support employees and managers in resolving workplace issues professionally and fairly. Maintain effective communication between management and employees. Understand employee needs and provide appropriate HR support. Promote professional behaviour, accountability and teamwork within the organisation. 
 4. Performance & Development 
 Support the implementation and monitoring of employee performance processes. Coordinate performance reviews and maintain relevant records. Work with managers to identify employee development needs. Support training, learning and development initiatives. Encourage continuous improvement and professional growth among employees. 
 5. HR Operations 
 Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation. Support onboarding and induction of new employees. Coordinate attendance, leave and other routine HR processes. Ensure timely completion of HR-related documentation and internal records. Support management in implementing HR policies and processes. Maintain confidentiality of employee and organisational information. 
 6. HR Planning & Management Support 
 Work closely with management on current and future manpower requirements. Provide HR-related insights and updates to management. Identify opportunities to improve employee experience and HR processes. Support organisational initiatives related to people, culture and performance. Take ownership of assigned HR projects and ensure timely execution. 
 Ideal Candidate 
 The ideal candidate will be: A people-oriented and approachable HR professional . Proactive, energetic and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Strong in communication and interpersonal skills. Capable of independently managing recruitment activities. Comfortable interacting with employees at different levels. Positive in approach and able to create a healthy workplace environment. Good at coordinating multiple HR activities simultaneously. Strong in follow-up, execution and maintaining HR records. Business-focused while maintaining an employee-centric approach. Mature and professional in handling confidential and sensitive matters. 
 Preferred Experience & Qualifications 
 4-10 years of relevant HR experience. Graduate/Postgraduate qualification in HR, Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field . Strong experience in recruitment and talent acquisition. Experience in employee engagement and employee relations. Experience in Tourism, Travel, Hospitality or other service-oriented industries will be an added advantage . Good working knowledge of MS Office/Google Workspace and HR/recruitment tools. 
 Languages 
 Hindi Mandatory Malayalam Preferred Good communication skills in English are expected. 
 Key Skills 
 Recruitment | Talent Acquisition | Employee Engagement | Employee Relations | People Management | Performance Management | HR Operations | Communication | Coordination | Conflict Resolution | Team Building | Culture Building 
 What We Are Looking For 
 We are looking for someone who sees HR not merely as an administrative function, but as a people and business function . The right candidate should be someone who can hire the right people, connect with employees, build positive energy within the organisation and create a workplace where people feel supported, motivated and accountable. 
 If you are an HR professional who enjoys working closely with people and wants to make a meaningful contribution to organisational growth, we would be happy to hear from you.
